description: This file defines the ProductRelationship entity class, which models relationships between products within the sales management system. It includes properties for related products, store association, and status flags, along with mapping annotations for ORM persistence.

classes.name: ProductRelationship
classes.description: Entity class representing product relationships, including references to related products, store, code, and active status.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the primary product in the relationship.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the primary product in the relationship.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether the relationship is active.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Returns the store associated with the relationship.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Sets the store for the relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the relationship.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the relationship.
